There are no sampling weights, entity-disjoint/source holdouts, quantitative uncertainty procedure or independently ascertained final-link denominator, yet dataset-wide precision/recall is proposed. technical_reasoning.rationale: Candidate deduplication/provenance, increased downstream workload, and changed scoring/calibration populations are reasoned correctly. However, an important assumption is missing: candidate-centered labels are not an independently established match universe, even when the starting sample is entity-centered. This materially invalidates the proposed coverage mechanism, rather than being a minor omission. Suggested vendor-conditioned keys also lack a checked cross-source attribute contract, and pair-score thresholds are inferred from a link-table deliverable without resolving linkage cardinality. Anchor 1 best reflects useful method descriptions with consequential missing assumptions; AU-02-F2 is missed in its non-admitted-pair and weighted-strata requirements.
